typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string (),
	userName as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Target DC} as string,
		{Data Hall} as string,
		ID as string,
		{Project Name} as string,
		{Ad Hoc Devices (QTY)} as string,
		{Ad Hoc RU (per device)} as string,
		{Device  Device Power} as string,
		Neighborhood as string,
		{DC Capacity Status} as string,
		{Integrated Racks CU} as string,
		Device as string,
		Taxonomy as string,
		{Year-Month} as string,
		{DCM Jira} as string,
		Status as string,
		{Taxonomy PTO Lab Power Value (Watts)} as string,
		{Sum of Power (kW)} as string,
		{Taxonomy Category} as string,
		{Manual Power Value} as string,
		Action as string,
		{Item Type} as string,
		Path as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(uploaddate = currentTimestamp(),
		ETLUser = $userName) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		Status as string,
		Path as string,
		Action as string,
		Item_Type as string,
		DC_Capacity_Status as string,
		Taxonomy as string,
		uploaddate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Device as string,
		Sum_of_Power__kW_ as string,
		Taxonomy_PTO_Lab_Power_Value__Watts_ as string,
		Project_Name as string,
		{Year-Month} as string,
		DCM_Jira as string,
		Device__Device_Power as string,
		Manual_Power_Value as string,
		Ad_Hoc_Devices__QTY_ as string,
		Neighborhood as string,
		Integrated_Racks_CU as string,
		ETLUser as string,
		Target_DC as string,
		Data_Hall as string,
		ID as string,
		Ad_Hoc_RU__per_device_ as string,
		Taxonomy_Category as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Status,
		Path,
		Action,
		Item_Type = {Item Type},
		DC_Capacity_Status = {DC Capacity Status},
		Taxonomy,
		uploaddate,
		Device,
		Sum_of_Power__kW_ = {Sum of Power (kW)},
		Taxonomy_PTO_Lab_Power_Value__Watts_ = {Taxonomy PTO Lab Power Value (Watts)},
		Project_Name = {Project Name},
		{Year-Month},
		DCM_Jira = {DCM Jira},
		Device__Device_Power = {Device  Device Power},
		Manual_Power_Value = {Manual Power Value},
		Ad_Hoc_Devices__QTY_ = {Ad Hoc Devices (QTY)},
		Neighborhood,
		Integrated_Racks_CU = {Integrated Racks CU},
		ETLUser,
		Target_DC = {Target DC},
		Data_Hall = {Data Hall},
		ID,
		Ad_Hoc_RU__per_device_ = {Ad Hoc RU (per device)},
		Taxonomy_Category = {Taxonomy Category}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
